source.qualification_scope: Authenticated upstream local molecular minimum; IR qualification is separate.

effective_electronic_settings.effective_potential_update: Full effective potential from the current density; no delta-DM update.
effective_electronic_settings.model_scope: Density-fitted Coulomb/JK integrals with def2-universal-jkfit; PBE XC quadrature remains numerical. This is a model approximation relative to the direct-integral reference, not a direct-SCF result.

richardson.interpretation: asymptotic estimate only; SCF/grid noise or higher orders can invalidate it

uncertainty_scope: Empirical displacement sensitivity; no claim of rigorous error bound, basis or solid-state validation
